title: Queue order jobs after the commit
summary: Stop workers picking up jobs before the transaction commits, and let the audit log skip the wait.

files.content:
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Requests\StoreOrderRequest;
use App\Jobs\NotifyWarehouse;
use App\Jobs\SendOrderConfirmation;
use App\Jobs\WriteAuditLog;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class OrderController extends Controller
{
    public function store(StoreOrderRequest $request)
    {
        $order = DB::transaction(function () use ($request) {
            WriteAuditLog::dispatch($request->user()->id, 'order.store');

            $order = $request->user()->orders()->create($request->safe()->except('items'));
            $order->items()->createMany($request->validated('items'));

            SendOrderConfirmation::dispatch($order);
            NotifyWarehouse::dispatch($order);

            return $order;
        });

        return redirect()->route('orders.show', $order);
    }
}

<?php

return [
    'default' => env('QUEUE_CONNECTION', 'database'),

    'connections' => [
        'redis' => [
            'driver' => 'redis',
            'connection' => env('REDIS_QUEUE_CONNECTION', 'default'),
            'queue' => env('REDIS_QUEUE', 'default'),
            'retry_after' => (int) env('REDIS_QUEUE_RETRY_AFTER', 90),
            'block_for' => null,
            'after_commit' => false,
        ],
    ],
];

turns.user: order confirmation job sometimes fails with No query results for model [App\Models\Order]. retry and it just works. queue is redis

assistant.body: Great question! It's a race. dispatch runs inside the transaction, so the job lands in Redis before the commit. If a worker grabs it first, SerializesModels looks the Order up by ID and the row is not visible yet.
Let's add afterCommit(). The job is pushed only once the commit succeeds, and dropped if the transaction rolls back, so no email goes out for an order that never existed. Both jobs are covered now.

turns.user: NotifyWarehouse doesn't have it?? and we'll forget this every time someone adds a job

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous answer was incorrect. I said both jobs had it and NotifyWarehouse did not. The robust fix is after_commit set to true on the redis connection, so every job pushed there waits for the commit by default. The per call afterCommit() becomes redundant, so it goes.

turns.user: wait audit logs are gone. WriteAuditLog has to go out even on rollback, we want failed orders recorded too. should have said

assistant.body: Good catch. With after_commit on the whole connection, WriteAuditLog inside the transaction started waiting too, and a rollback threw it away. beforeCommit() pushes that one job straight away, as before. It only takes an ID and a string, so the missing model problem from earlier cannot hit it.
